question:
With reference to the Unified Payments Interface (UPI) charging framework notified in September 2026, consider the following statements:
1. A Merchant Discount Rate of 0.4%, subject to a cap of Rs 300 per transaction, applies to person-to-merchant payments exceeding Rs 2,000.
2. Person-to-person transfers above Rs 2,000 attract the same Merchant Discount Rate as person-to-merchant payments.
3. Small merchants in the Person-to-Person-Merchant (P2PM) category receiving up to Rs 1 lakh per month through UPI QR codes are exempt from the Merchant Discount Rate.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
explanation: Statement 2 is wrong: all person-to-person transfers remain completely free regardless of amount, and the Rs 2,000 threshold applies only to eligible person-to-merchant transactions. Statements 1 and 3 restate the framework notified on 15 September 2026 under the PSS Act, 2007 - a general MDR of 0.4% capped at Rs 300 on P2M above Rs 2,000, and zero MDR for P2PM small merchants receiving up to Rs 1 lakh a month via UPI QR.
subject: Economy
theme: Digital payments and Digital Public Infrastructure
micro_topic: UPI Merchant Discount Rate framework notified 15 September 2026 under the Payment and Settlement Systems Act, 2007, rates settled by the UPI Steering Committee; general MDR 0.4% on P2M above Rs 2,000 capped at Rs 300 (cap binds from Rs 75,000); flat Rs 5 for essential and thin-margin sectors (railways, telecom, insurance, fuel, agricultural inputs); 0.02% capped at Rs 300 for capital markets; all P2P free; P2M up to Rs 2,000 free; P2PM small merchants up to Rs 1 lakh per month free; about 96% of P2M transactions unaffected; P2P about 70% of UPI value; 5% of MDR collections to a small-merchant fund; reverses zero MDR in force since 1 January 2020 under Section 10A of the PSS Act

question:
Consider the following statements regarding the Gujarat Action Plan for Great Indian Bustard Conservation released in September 2026:
1. It was prepared by the Wildlife Institute of India in association with the Gujarat Forest Department.
2. It identifies the Lala-Rawa landscape in Kachchh as the priority habitat.
3. A Soft Release Centre for captive-bred Great Indian Bustards was inaugurated near Naliya.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
explanation: All three are correct. The plan, released at Bhuj on 15 September 2026, was authored by the Wildlife Institute of India with the Gujarat Forest Department, names Lala-Rawa (about 200 sq. km) in Kachchh as the priority landscape, and was released alongside the inauguration of a GIB Soft Release Centre near Naliya for captive-bred birds brought from Rajasthan.
subject: Environment
theme: Species recovery programmes and grassland conservation
micro_topic: Gujarat Action Plan for Great Indian Bustard Conservation released at Bhuj, Kachchh on 15 September 2026; prepared by Wildlife Institute of India with Gujarat Forest Department; target of a minimum viable population of 30+ birds over 200-500 sq. km of contiguous habitat; priority landscape Lala-Rawa (~200 sq. km); about 11 sq. km of Prosopis juliflora-infested grassland restored at Naliya; 30 km predator-proof fencing over 15 sq. km; GIB Soft Release Centre near Naliya; jump-start breeding technique swapping infertile wild-laid eggs for viable eggs; Great Indian Bustard (Ardeotis nigriceps) IUCN Critically Endangered, Schedule I of Wildlife (Protection) Act 1972, State bird of Rajasthan

question:
With reference to the India-Vietnam defence engagement held in New Delhi in September 2026, consider the following statements:
1. The two sides agreed to hold the next Defence Policy Dialogue on the sidelines of Aero India 2027.
2. Both countries underlined the ASEAN Defence Ministers' Meeting-Plus and its Experts' Working Groups as platforms for practical defence cooperation.
3. India and Vietnam elevated their relationship to a Comprehensive Strategic Partnership at this meeting.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
explanation: Statement 3 is wrong on two counts: the Comprehensive Strategic Partnership dates from 2016, and the relationship had already been elevated to an Enhanced Comprehensive Strategic Partnership in May 2026. The 13 September 2026 engagement was a Defence Secretary-level meeting on the sidelines of the 18th BRICS Summit between Rajesh Kumar Singh and Senior Lieutenant General Nguyen Truong Thang, which agreed to move towards joint production of defence equipment, emphasised ADMM-Plus, and fixed the next Defence Policy Dialogue for the sidelines of Aero India 2027.
subject: International Relations
theme: Act East Policy and defence-industrial diplomacy
micro_topic: India-Vietnam Defence Secretary-level meeting New Delhi 13 September 2026 on BRICS Summit sidelines; Rajesh Kumar Singh and Sr Lt Gen Nguyen Truong Thang; shift to joint production and technology transfer; ADMM-Plus Experts' Working Groups; next Defence Policy Dialogue at Aero India 2027; diplomatic relations 1972, Strategic Partnership 2007, Comprehensive Strategic Partnership 2016, Enhanced Comprehensive Strategic Partnership May 2026; 2027 as Year of India-Vietnam Friendship marking 55 years; INS Kirpan transferred 2023; 12 high-speed patrol boats under US$100 million Line of Credit; further US$300 million LoC; bilateral trade target US$25 billion by 2030; Vietnam in the Indo-Pacific Oceans Initiative

question: According to the monthly Periodic Labour Force Survey (PLFS) bulletin for August 2026, which one of the following statements is correct?
options: (a) Both the rural and the urban unemployment rates declined compared with July 2026.
(b) The rural unemployment rate declined while the urban unemployment rate rose marginally compared with July 2026.
(c) The all-India unemployment rate rose to 5.1% from 5.0% in July 2026.
(d) The female labour force participation rate declined, driven by a fall in rural female participation.
explanation: The all-India unemployment rate for persons aged 15 years and above eased to 5.0% in August 2026 from 5.1% in July. Rural unemployment fell to 4.1%, the lowest since January 2026, while urban unemployment edged up to 6.8% from 6.7%. Option (c) reverses the direction of change, and option (d) is the reverse of the actual movement - female LFPR rose to 34.8% from 34.4%, led by rural female LFPR rising to 39.4% from 38.8%.
subject: Reports & Indices
theme: Labour force statistics and employment measurement
micro_topic: Monthly PLFS bulletin for August 2026 released by MoSPI on 16 September 2026; all-India unemployment rate 5.0% for age 15+ (July 5.1%); rural 4.1%, lowest since January 2026, against 4.3% a year earlier; urban 6.8% (July 6.7%); rural LFPR 58.2% (from 58.0%); urban LFPR 50.4% unchanged; all-India female LFPR 34.8% (from 34.4%); rural female LFPR 39.4% (from 38.8%); PLFS launched by NSO in April 2017 replacing quinquennial NSSO Employment-Unemployment Surveys; January 2025 revamp introduced monthly estimates; monthly estimates use Current Weekly Status

question: The Indian Cyber Crime Coordination Centre (I4C), recently in the news in connection with the direct reporting of child sexual abuse material by a social media intermediary, functions under which one of the following?
options: (a) Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
(c) Ministry of Women and Child Development
explanation: I4C is an initiative of the Ministry of Home Affairs, operationalised in 2020, which runs the National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal (cybercrime.gov.in) and the 1930 helpline. Meta has committed to report child safety cases directly to this portal instead of routing them only through the US-based NCMEC. CERT-In is under MeitY and the NCPCR is under the Ministry of Women and Child Development.
subject: Society
micro_topic: Meta agrees to report child safety cases directly to India's I4C cybercrime portal, September 2026; earlier route was the US-based National Center for Missing and Exploited Children (NCMEC) CyberTipline under the NCRB-NCMEC MoU of 2019; over 69 lakh CyberTipline reports shared with States/UTs by March 2024; followed a BBC Eye investigation on Instagram CSAM advertisements and NCPCR summons, with Meta India appearing on 9 September 2026; I4C under MHA operationalised 2020, runs cybercrime.gov.in and the 1930 helpline; verticals include National Cybercrime Threat Analytics Unit, National Cybercrime Forensic Laboratory, CyTrain and Joint Cybercrime Coordination Teams

question:
Consider the following pairs:
Institution : Parent Ministry / Organisation
1. Indian Computer Emergency Response Team (CERT-In) : Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
2. National Critical Information Infrastructure Protection Centre (NCIIPC) : National Technical Research Organisation
3. National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal : Ministry of Home Affairs
How many of the pairs given above are correctly matched?
explanation: All three are correctly matched. CERT-In is the national nodal agency for cyber incident response under MeitY, given statutory status by Section 70B of the IT Act, 2000. NCIIPC was designated under Section 70A of the IT Act and functions as a unit of the National Technical Research Organisation. The National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal is run by I4C under the Ministry of Home Affairs. India's cyber architecture is deliberately split between MeitY (incident response), NTRO (critical infrastructure protection) and MHA (cybercrime reporting and investigation).
subject: Internal Security
micro_topic: CERT-In under MeitY, statutory under Section 70B of the Information Technology Act 2000; NCIIPC designated under Section 70A and functioning as a unit of the National Technical Research Organisation; National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal and 1930 helpline run by I4C under the Ministry of Home Affairs; other components include the National Cyber Coordination Centre and Cyber Swachhta Kendra

question:
With reference to the National Commission for Protection of Child Rights (NCPCR), consider the following statements:
1. It is a constitutional body established under Article 338B of the Constitution.
2. It has been vested with the powers of a civil court while inquiring into matters within its mandate.
3. It is designated to monitor the implementation of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences (POCSO) Act, 2012.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
explanation: Statement 1 is wrong: the NCPCR is a statutory body constituted under the Commissions for Protection of Child Rights (CPCR) Act, 2005, functioning under the Ministry of Women and Child Development. Article 338B of the Constitution establishes the National Commission for Backward Classes. The NCPCR does enjoy the powers of a civil court in its inquiries and is the designated monitoring authority for the POCSO Act, 2012.
subject: Polity & Governance
micro_topic: National Commission for Protection of Child Rights constituted under the Commissions for Protection of Child Rights Act 2005, a statutory body under the Ministry of Women and Child Development; powers of a civil court in inquiries; designated monitoring authority for the POCSO Act 2012 and for the Right to Education Act 2009; distinction from constitutional commissions such as the National Commission for Backward Classes under Article 338B, the National Commission for Scheduled Castes under Article 338 and the National Commission for Scheduled Tribes under Article 338A
